# Library Lending: user manual

Version 0.1.0 of the specification: 1 task, 11 pages and 0 commands. For the people who use the system: who may open which page, how to reach it, the tasks done across pages step by step, what each page asks for and answers, and what each command takes, does and answers.

A small public library lends books to its members. Members borrow a copy,
keep it for a fixed loan period, and pay a late fee when they return it
after the due date. This example exists to exercise every concept of the
meta-model in one place, across every stage of the life cycle; it is not
a real library's system.

## 1. Who uses it

Each role a person holds, and the pages it opens. A person holding several roles opens the pages of each.

| Role | Who they are | Pages they open |
|---|---|---|
| librarian | Staff at the desk. | Ask to waive a late fee, Lend a copy, Loans, Register member, Lend copies, Member, Members |
| head-librarian | Staff who decide what a lost copy costs the library; they do not lend. | Loans |
| member | A card holder, who sees only their own loans. | Loans |
| desk-supervisor | The supervisor of the desk, who approves what one librarian may not do alone. | Fee waivers to approve, Loans |

**Insight on member:** A member reads only the loans whose memberId is their own; the rule is written here once and holds for every operation, page and job that reads a loan, and a caller with no member identifier reaches no loan through it.

Anyone opens these pages, signed in or not: Set a new password, Confirm it is you, Sign in.

## 2. Finding your way

The menus, and the page each entry opens. An entry is shown only to who may open its page.

- Members
  - All members: opens the Members page
  - Register a member: opens the Register member page
- Loans
  - All loans: opens the Loans page
  - Lend a copy: opens the Lend a copy page
  - Fee waivers to approve: opens the Fee waivers to approve page

## 3. Tasks

### lend-a-copy

A librarian finds the member at the desk, opens their record and lends them a copy.

Done by librarian: Staff at the desk.

1. Open Members › All members from the menu.
2. On the Members page, select the row you want.
3. On the Member page, choose Lend a book.
4. On the Lend a copy page, fill in Member, Book, Lent on and Due on, and send it.

## 4. Pages

### Ask to waive a late fee

Reached from the action Ask to waive the fee on the Loans page.

Opened by librarian (the permission fees.request).

| Field | What to enter | Required |
|---|---|---|
| Amount to waive |   | yes |
| Reason |   | yes |

Once it is sent: Sent for approval. A desk supervisor answers within three days. The Loans page opens.

### Fee waivers to approve

Reached from the menu Loans › Fee waivers to approve.

Opened by desk-supervisor (the permission fees.approve).

| Column | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Loan |   |
| Amount to waive |   |
| Reason |   |

What can be done here:

- **Approve**: Approve a request to waive a late fee, at its approve step. It asks first: "Approve waiving this fee?". Then: The request is approved and the fee is waived.
- **Refuse**: Refuse a request to waive a late fee, at its approve step, saying why. It asks first: "Refuse this request? The fee stands.", and for the reason. Then: The request is refused.

### Lend a copy

Reached from the menu Loans › Lend a copy and the action Lend a book on the Member page.

Opened by librarian (the permission loans.create).

| Field | What to enter | Required |
|---|---|---|
| Member |   | yes |
| Book |   | yes |
| Lent on | The day the copy left the desk: today, or an earlier day for a loan the desk made while the system was down. Null for a loan recorded before the desk gave the day, which was lent on the day of loanedAt. | yes |
| Due on | The day the copy is due back, no later than the member's tier allows. | yes |

Checked before it is sent: A copy is due after the day it is lent.

Once it is sent: The copy is lent. The Member page opens.

When the system refuses:

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| This member cannot borrow now: the loan limit is reached, fees are outstanding, no copy is available, or the due day is later than the tier allows. | The member is inactive, holds the most open loans their tier allows or has outstanding fees, or the book has no copy available. | Open the member's record: return a copy first, settle the fees, or pick an earlier due day; for a book with no copy left, the member waits for one to come back. |

### Loans

Reached from the menu Loans › All loans.

Opened by librarian, head-librarian, member and desk-supervisor (the permission loans.read).

| Column | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Member |   |
| Book |   |
| Recorded at | When the loan was recorded. |
| Due on | The day the copy is due back, no later than the member's tier allows. |
| Status |   |
| Late fee | Computed by the lateFee algorithm when the copy is returned; zero until then. |

The list can be narrowed by Status and Member.

What can be done here:

- **Return**: Record the return of a copy. It asks first: "Record this copy as returned?". Offered only while status == "open" || status == "overdue". Shown to librarian (the permission loans.return). Then: The copy is recorded as returned.
- **Lost**: Record a lost copy and charge its replacement cost. It asks first: "Charge the replacement cost and close this loan?". Offered only while status == "open" || status == "overdue". Shown to librarian (the permission loans.return). Then: The loan is closed and the replacement cost charged.
- **Ask to waive the fee**: opens the Ask to waive a late fee page. Offered only while status == "returned". Shown to librarian (the permission fees.request).

When the system refuses:

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| This loan was already closed, so nothing changed. | The loan was returned or reported lost before. | Nothing to do: the loan is closed already. Refresh the list to see it as it is. |
| The loans cannot be shown or changed right now. Try again in a moment. | Any other problem the system reports. |   |

### Register member

Reached from the menu Members › Register a member and the action New member on the Members page.

Opened by librarian (the permission members.write).

| Field | What to enter | Required |
|---|---|---|
| Full name |   | yes |
| Email address | Encrypted at rest, and found by a salted hash of it, since it must stay unique. | yes |
| Tier |   | yes |
| Address |   |  |
| Phone numbers |   |  |

Once it is sent: The member is registered. The Member page opens.

When the system refuses:

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| Another member already has this email address. | A member with the same email address exists. | Look the member up by the email address in the list of members; they are registered already. |

### Lend copies

The member's loans are loaded and shown locked; the desk adds a row per copy lent, up to the six open loans the extended tier allows. The member's own tier limit is the server's check.

Reached from the action Lend copies on the Member page.

Opened by librarian (the permission loans.create).

| Field | What to enter | Required |
|---|---|---|
| Membership ends on | The last day the card is valid; set a year after joining and moved on by each renewal. | yes |
| Outstanding fees | Sum of unpaid late fees and replacement charges, in the library's currency. | yes |

Loans are added as rows, each with Book and Due on, up to 6.

Once it is sent: The copies are lent. The Member page opens.

When the system refuses:

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| There is no member with this card. | No member has the id in the path. |   |
| This member cannot borrow these copies now: the loan limit is reached, fees are outstanding, or a copy is not available. | The member is inactive, holds the most open loans their tier allows or has outstanding fees, or the book has no copy available. | Open the member's record: return a copy first, settle the fees, or pick an earlier due day; for a book with no copy left, the member waits for one to come back. |

### Member

Reached from a row selected on the Members page.

Opened by librarian (the permission members.read).

| Field | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Card number | Printed on the card; assigned when the member joins. |
| Full name |   |
| Email address | Encrypted at rest, and found by a salted hash of it, since it must stay unique. |
| Tier |   |
| Joined on |   |
| Membership ends on | The last day the card is valid; set a year after joining and moved on by each renewal. |
| Outstanding fees | Sum of unpaid late fees and replacement charges, in the library's currency. |
| Address |   |
| Phone numbers |   |

What can be done here:

- **Lend a book**: opens the Lend a copy page. Shown to librarian (the permission loans.create).
- **Lend copies**: opens the Lend copies page. Shown to librarian (the permission loans.create).
- **Deactivate**: Deactivate a member, who then borrows nothing more. It asks first: "Deactivate this member? They will borrow nothing more.", and for the reason. Offered only while status == "active". Shown to librarian (the permission members.write). Then: The member is deactivated.

When the system refuses:

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| There is no member with this card. | No member has the id in the path. |   |

Reached from the menu Members › All members.

Opened by librarian (the permission members.read).

- **Deactivate**: Deactivate a member, who then borrows nothing more. It asks first: "Deactivate this member? They will borrow nothing more.", and for the reason. Offered only while status == "active". Shown to librarian (the permission members.write). Then: The member is deactivated.

When the system refuses:

### Set a new password

Anyone opens it, signed in or not.

| Field | What to enter | Required |
|---|---|---|
| Reset code |   | yes |
| New password |   | yes |
| New password again |   | yes |

Checked before it is sent: The two passwords are not the same.

Once it is sent: Your password is set. Sign in with it. The Sign in page opens.

When the system refuses:

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| The reset code is wrong, used or expired. Ask for a new one. | No one was sent the reset code, or it was used or has expired. |   |

### Confirm it is you

Anyone opens it, signed in or not.

| Field | What to enter | Required |
|---|---|---|
| Code from the authenticator app |   | yes |

Once it is sent: You are signed in. The Members page opens.

When the system refuses:

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| The code is wrong, or it came too late. Type the code the app shows now, or sign in again. | The code is not the one the authenticator app shows now, or the sign-in challenge is closed after five wrong codes or five minutes. | Type the code the authenticator app shows now, or sign in again. |

### Sign in

Anyone opens it, signed in or not.

| Field | What to enter | Required |
|---|---|---|
| Email address |   | yes |
| Password |   | yes |

Once it is sent: You are signed in. The Members page opens. Or: The Confirm it is you page opens.

When the system refuses:

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| The email address or the password is wrong. | No one has the email address, or the password does not match it. | Type the email address and the password again; after a forgotten password, reset it. |
